name: Chikan Circle 3 ~Chijoku no Diagram Kanketsu Hen~
original_name: 痴漢サークル3～恥辱のダイヤグラム・完結篇～
source:
Junichi is a university student. He joined the "Chikan (molestation) Circle" a while ago and now enjoys Chikan life with Yui and other members. His next target girl is Mizuka, who is a train security guard. Her daughter, Ayaka, is now a member of the circle, so Junichi tries to recruit Mizuka using Ayaka. At the same time, Junichi meets Risa, another train security guard. He decides to recruit Risa as well....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
纯一是一名大学生。不久前，他加入了“痴汉社团”，如今与由衣等成员一同享受痴汉生活。他的下一个目标是担任列车保安的水香。水香的女儿绫香已经加入社团，于是纯一试图利用她招募水香。与此同时，他遇见了另一名列车保安理沙，并决定也把理沙拉进社团…
